RUN 1/6 -- PLEDGE PHASE. Reply with [pledge: escort] or [pledge: scout].

Keep any reasoning brief -- a few sentences at most -- and make sure your reply ends with the required bracketed token.

To secure the high reward of 40 cargo, I must attempt to get everyone to pledge escort. Pledging safeguarding the convoy (escort) maximizes the potential payout if others cooperate, whereas scouting offers a guaranteed but lower individual gain (10 stolen + 6 split = 16 vs potential 10 split = 10). I will pledge escort to incentivize the rich road.
